items.title: Hawkins, Inc. to Participate in Sidoti & Company’s Year-End Virtual Investor Conference
items.summary: Hawkins, Inc. announced that Chief Financial Officer Jeff Oldenkamp will participate in Sidoti & Company's Year-End Virtual Investor Conference on December 9-10, 2026. The CFO will be available for one-on-one and small group meetings. Hawkins is a leading water treatment and specialty ingredients company with approximately $1.1 billion in fiscal 2026 revenue and 1,200 employees across 69 facilities in 28 states.
